7990.title: Native shell leaves page scaling unconstrained
7990.rootCauseOneLine: The native shell has no explicit page-scale policy and its real bridge leaves the app viewport unconstrained; native gestures remain unverified.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only; no PR code executed. Native gesture behavior remains unverified.

7990.proposedFix: First reproduce pinch and double-tap on iOS; then enforce shell-only scale while preserving existing viewport directives and app-local gestures.
7990.caveats: Linux host has no iOS simulator/device. No native screenshots or native gesture reproduction. Viewport diagnostic repeated in two clean checkouts; no fix PR is safe under the requested gate. Full build is blocked by unrelated missing plugin SDK dist files.
